approval_decisions_revision_check.name: approval_decisions_revision_check
approval_decisions_revision_check.value: (("approval_decisions"."kind" = 'revision_requested') = ("approval_decisions"."revision" IS NOT NULL)) AND ("approval_decisions"."revision" IS NULL OR (pg_column_size("approval_decisions"."revision") <= 16384 AND jsonb_typeof("approval_decisions"."revision") = 'object'))

approval_decisions_checklist_check.name: approval_decisions_checklist_check
approval_decisions_checklist_check.value: (("approval_decisions"."kind" = 'approved') = ("approval_decisions"."checklist" IS NOT NULL)) AND ("approval_decisions"."checklist" IS NULL OR "approval_decisions"."checklist" = '{"watched":true,"imagery":true,"presentation":true,"claims":true,"disclosure":true,"rights":true,"affiliate":true}'::jsonb)

campaign_runs_request_hash_check.name: campaign_runs_request_hash_check
campaign_runs_request_hash_check.value: ("campaign_runs"."campaign_request_hash" IS NOT NULL) = ("campaign_runs"."workflow" = 'campaign-v1') AND ("campaign_runs"."campaign_request_hash" IS NULL OR "campaign_runs"."campaign_request_hash" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$')

pixel_deliverables_format_check.name: pixel_deliverables_format_check
pixel_deliverables_format_check.value: "pixel_deliverables"."width" = 1080 AND "pixel_deliverables"."height" = 1920 AND "pixel_deliverables"."fps" = 30 AND "pixel_deliverables"."video_codec" = 'h264' AND "pixel_deliverables"."pixel_format" = 'yuv420p' AND NOT "pixel_deliverables"."audio" AND "pixel_deliverables"."duration_ms" BETWEEN 14900 AND 30100 AND "pixel_deliverables"."byte_size" > 0

pixel_render_jobs_text_check.name: pixel_render_jobs_text_check
pixel_render_jobs_text_check.value: ("pixel_render_jobs"."error" IS NULL OR char_length("pixel_render_jobs"."error") <= 500) AND ("pixel_render_jobs"."progress" IS NULL OR pg_column_size("pixel_render_jobs"."progress") <= 1024)

quill_scene_claims_size_check.name: quill_scene_claims_size_check
quill_scene_claims_size_check.value: char_length("quill_scene_claims"."statement") BETWEEN 1 AND 500 AND cardinality("quill_scene_claims"."evidence_keys") BETWEEN 1 AND 20 AND pg_column_size("quill_scene_claims"."evidence") <= 8192

quill_scenes_text_check.name: quill_scenes_text_check
quill_scenes_text_check.value: char_length("quill_scenes"."narration") BETWEEN 1 AND 400 AND char_length("quill_scenes"."caption") BETWEEN 1 AND 80 AND ("quill_scenes"."subtext" IS NULL OR char_length("quill_scenes"."subtext") <= 60) AND char_length("quill_scenes"."visual") <= 300

run_product_snapshots_campaign_selection.name: run_product_snapshots_campaign_selection_check
run_product_snapshots_campaign_selection.value:
("run_product_snapshots"."campaign_selection" IS NULL) = ("run_product_snapshots"."campaign_selection_checksum" IS NULL) AND
          ("run_product_snapshots"."campaign_selection" IS NULL OR (jsonb_typeof("run_product_snapshots"."campaign_selection") = 'object' AND
            pg_column_size("run_product_snapshots"."campaign_selection") <= 4096 AND "run_product_snapshots"."campaign_selection_checksum" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'))

scout_claims_text_check.name: scout_claims_text_check
scout_claims_text_check.value: char_length("scout_claims"."statement") BETWEEN 1 AND 500 AND char_length("scout_claims"."reason") <= 300 AND ("scout_claims"."attribute" IS NULL OR char_length("scout_claims"."attribute") <= 80) AND ("scout_claims"."value" IS NULL OR char_length("scout_claims"."value") <= 200)

scout_evidence_fields_check.name: scout_evidence_fields_check
scout_evidence_fields_check.value: ("scout_evidence"."attribute" IS NULL OR char_length("scout_evidence"."attribute") <= 80) AND ("scout_evidence"."value" IS NULL OR char_length("scout_evidence"."value") <= 200) AND ("scout_evidence"."model" IS NULL OR char_length("scout_evidence"."model") <= 120)

scout_sources_read_check.name: scout_sources_read_check
scout_sources_read_check.value: ("scout_sources"."outcome" = 'ok') = "scout_sources"."identified" AND ("scout_sources"."content_sha256" IS NULL OR "scout_sources"."retrieved_at" IS NOT NULL)

ticket_assets_kind_check.name: ticket_assets_kind_check
ticket_assets_kind_check.value:
("ticket_assets"."kind" = 'image' AND "ticket_assets"."mime_type" IN ('image/jpeg', 'image/png', 'image/webp') AND "ticket_assets"."duration_ms" IS NULL)
        OR ("ticket_assets"."kind" = 'video' AND "ticket_assets"."mime_type" = 'video/mp4' AND "ticket_assets"."duration_ms" IS NOT NULL)

worker_tasks_lease_check.name: worker_tasks_lease_check
worker_tasks_lease_check.value: ("worker_tasks"."status" = 'running') = ("worker_tasks"."lease_owner" IS NOT NULL AND "worker_tasks"."lease_expires_at" IS NOT NULL)
